hero.imageAlt: Ecram Execs chauffeur waiting beside an electric Mercedes VLE as an executive leaves a private jet at dusk
hero.intro: Experience premium electric chauffeur services across the Netherlands, combining refined comfort, discretion, and effortless travel. From collection to arrival, every journey is tailored around your comfort, with punctuality and exceptional service at the heart of every ride.
hero.stripServing: SERVING THE WHOLE OF THE NETHERLANDS

servicesSection.heading: Executive chauffeur services, end to end.
servicesSection.intro: Professionalism, punctuality, discretion and attention to detail — whether you are travelling for business or for leisure.
servicesSection.airportText: Flight-tracked collections at Schiphol, Rotterdam The Hague and Eindhoven. Met in arrivals, luggage handled, straight to the cabin.
servicesSection.businessText: Meetings, roadshows and site visits, with a chauffeur who waits as directed. A quiet cabin in which to prepare, call or rest.
servicesSection.corporateText: A single point of contact for your organisation, consolidated invoicing and dependable cover for executives and guests.
servicesSection.privateText: Weddings, celebrations and evenings out, attended to with the same composure as a board meeting.
servicesSection.hotelsText: A trusted partner for hotels and concierge desks welcoming international guests to the Netherlands.
servicesSection.bespokeText: Multi-day delegations, events and itineraries planned around your requirements, not ours.

experienceSection.heading: The arrival, as you will see it.
experienceSection.step1Text: Your vehicle is in place before you are, without fuss.
experienceSection.step2Text: A personal welcome from a chauffeur who knows your name and your plans.
experienceSection.step3Text: Taken care of, from the kerb to the boot and back again.
experienceSection.step4Text: Settle into a silent, lounge-like interior prepared for you.
experienceSection.step5Text: Work, talk or simply rest. We take care of everything else.

fleetSection.intro: Selected for uncompromising comfort, silent powertrain performance, and executive refinement. Our fleet consists strictly of top-of-the-range, fully electric vehicles from leading luxury manufacturers each finished in obsidian black with tailored black executive interiors.
fleetSection.specNote: Every vehicle operates strictly in an all-black exterior finish with a black executive leather interior, in full top-of-the-range specification.
fleetSection.interiorAlt: Rear cabin with black executive leather seating

electric.heading: Sustainability and luxury need not be separate.
electric.body: As a Netherlands-based company, we are building a modern, fully electric executive fleet, contributing directly to the Dutch transition toward cleaner, future-focused mobility. Operating a 100% BEV fleet with zero tailpipe emissions, electric drive delivers a quieter, smoother journey: precisely the calm our service is built upon. For our corporate partners, every journey includes complete Scope 3 ESG audit reporting to effortlessly support your sustainability targets.

destinationsSection.heading: Wherever you need to be.
destinationsSection.intro: From the boardrooms of Zuidas to the windmills of Kinderdijk — one standard of service, from province to province.

destinationsSection.bulbRegionAlt: Tulip fields in the Dutch bulb region

whoWeServe.heading: Trusted by those for whom every minute — and every impression — counts.
whoWeServe.valueDiscretionText: What is said in the car stays in the car.
whoWeServe.valuePunctualityText: Early is on time. Flights tracked, routes planned.
whoWeServe.valueDetailText: Your temperature, your music, your newspaper.

conciergeSection.body: Our digital concierge answers questions, explains our services and begins your quotation at any hour. When a request deserves a personal conversation, it hands you to a member of our team — seamlessly.
conciergeSection.chatGuest1: I land at Schiphol on Thursday at 07:40 and need to be in Eindhoven by 10:00.
conciergeSection.chatAgent1: Certainly. Your chauffeur will track your flight and meet you in arrivals. May I ask how many passengers, and roughly how much luggage?
conciergeSection.chatGuest2: Two of us, two cases. Can the car wait and bring us back in the evening?
conciergeSection.chatAgent2: Of course. For a return with waiting time, I'll pass you to our reservations team for a tailored quotation — they'll reply shortly.

finalCta.body: Every journey is different, so every quotation is personal. Tell us where, when and how — we will respond promptly.

driveWithUs.metaDescription: Independent chauffeur with your own fully electric luxury car? Apply to join the Ecram Execs platform — we check your car against our criteria instantly.
driveWithUs.intro: Are you an independent chauffeur with your own executive electric car? Join the Ecram Execs platform and drive for discerning business and private clients across the Netherlands — on your own schedule, with your own car.
driveWithUs.step1Text: Enter your licence plate and details, and upload your documents. We check your car against the RDW register instantly.
driveWithUs.step2Text: We arrange a short introduction and inspect your car and documents in person.
driveWithUs.step3Text: Once approved you join our platform and receive executive journeys across the Netherlands.

driveWithUs.documentsNote: With your application you upload your chauffeur card (chauffeurskaart / taxipas), a KvK extract, a VOG (profile 70) and proof of insurance for paid passenger transport. You will also need a Kiwa taxi transport licence. We check the originals in person before you start.

privacy.metaDescription: How Ecram Execs collects, uses and protects your personal data.
privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.s1Intro: {name} provides executive chauffeur services in the Netherlands and is the controller of the personal data described here{registered}{kvk}. Questions about this policy can be sent to
privacy.s2p1: When you request a quotation we collect your name, email address, phone number, the collection point, destination, date and time of your journey, the service and number of passengers you select, and any notes you add. If you send a bespoke inquiry we also collect your company or account name, the size of your delegation, your vehicle class requirements, your itinerary and special instructions, and whether you prefer to be contacted by phone or WhatsApp. We use this only to prepare and send your quotation or programme, arrange your journey and contact you about it. The legal basis is taking steps at your request before entering into a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
privacy.s2p2: When you apply to drive with us we collect your name, email address, phone number, KvK number, years of driving experience, your car's licence plate and any notes you add. We look the plate up in the public register of the RDW (the Dutch vehicle authority) to check the car against our criteria, and store the make, model, colour, seating, registration dates and taxi registration it returns. You also upload copies of your chauffeur card, KvK extract, certificate of conduct (VOG) and insurance; these are stored in a private storage area that only our team can open. We use this only to assess your application and, if it is approved, to work with you. The legal basis is taking steps at your request before entering into a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
privacy.s2p3: To protect the forms against abuse we also store a one-way, salted hash of your IP address and your browser's user-agent string. The hash cannot be turned back into your IP address. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in keeping the service secure (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.s3p1: The public website does not use tracking or advertising cookies. A strictly necessary session cookie is used only when our staff sign in to the internal reservations system.
privacy.s4p1: We use carefully selected service providers who process data on our behalf under data processing agreements:
privacy.s4Supabase: Supabase — database and document storage, in the European Union
privacy.s4Resend: Resend — delivery of email notifications about your request
privacy.s4p2: We do not sell your data or share it with third parties for marketing.
privacy.s5p1: Quotation and bespoke requests are kept for up to 24 months after our last contact with you, so we can handle follow-up questions and repeat bookings. Driver applications that do not lead to a partnership, including the documents uploaded with them, are kept for up to 12 months. Information that forms part of our financial records is kept for seven years, as Dutch tax law requires. You can ask us to delete your request at any time.
privacy.s6p1: You have the right to access, correct or delete your personal data, to restrict or object to its processing, and to receive it in a portable format. Contact us at
privacy.s6p2: and we will respond within one month. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (
privacy.s7p1: Your data is transmitted over encrypted connections and stored in access-controlled systems. Only authorised staff can view quotation and bespoke requests and driver applications.
